files_summary.pubmed.json: PubMed-style article database of 66 realistic biomedical publications (2015-2024) spanning COVID-19/mRNA vaccines, CRISPR/gene editing, cancer/oncology, deep learning/AI in medicine, cardiology, neuroscience/Alzheimer's, diabetes/endocrinology, infectious disease, public health, psychiatry, stroke/neurology, nephrology/hepatology/autoimmune, rare disease/pediatrics, aging, pharmacology, surgery, and pulmonology. Each article has pmid, title, authors, journal, year, abstract, and lowercase keywords. Authors, journals, and keywords are reused across multiple articles to enable multi-hop author/journal/keyword searches.
files_summary.README.md: Schema, lifecycles and business rules of this benchmark's datastore.

tool_schemas.name: pubmed_search_pubmed_key_words
tool_schemas.description: Searches PubMed using a free-text keywords query and returns a list of matching articles (up to num_results) with identifiers and basic metadata suitable for later retrieval. It refuses requests that omit key_words, provide an empty/whitespace-only keywords string, or pass a non-integer or non-positive num_results. It also refuses requests when PubMed cannot be reached or the query cannot be executed against PubMed.

tool_schemas.name: pubmed_search_pubmed_advanced
tool_schemas.description: Runs an advanced PubMed search by combining the provided fields (term, title, author, journal, and optional start/end date filters) and returns a list of matching articles (up to num_results) with identifiers and basic metadata. It refuses requests that provide none of the search fields (term/title/author/journal) or that pass invalid filters, such as malformed dates, an end_date earlier than start_date, or a non-integer or non-positive num_results. It also refuses requests when PubMed cannot be reached or the query cannot be executed against PubMed.

tool_schemas.name: pubmed_get_pubmed_article_metadata
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the stored or freshly fetched PubMed metadata for a single article identified by pmid (for example: title, authors, journal, publication details, and available links). It refuses requests with a missing pmid, a pmid that is not a valid PubMed identifier, or a pmid that does not resolve to an article. It also refuses requests when PubMed cannot be reached to resolve an unknown pmid.

tool_schemas.name: pubmed_download_pubmed_pdf
tool_schemas.description: Attempts to locate and download a PDF for the PubMed article identified by pmid and returns the PDF content when an accessible full-text source is available. It refuses requests with a missing or invalid pmid, with a pmid that does not resolve to an article, or when no PDF link is available for that article. It also refuses requests when the PDF is not accessible due to publisher/permission restrictions or when the full-text source cannot be reached.

metadata.name: HelioMed Literature Vault
metadata.description: Searches biomedical literature by keywords or advanced queries, then saves and serves retrieved article metadata and PDFs for later reference and use.
